title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: Repayment Plan Requests and the Months Requested
content:
## Situation of use and capability

A repayment plan request on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** records the number of months the plan is to run, and that number is the longest term the debtor qualifies for. A plan of up to the longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report is approved on request. A Financial Status Report reaches a debt only with a request the debtor signs; a repayment plan request recorded by a representative carries none.

For a debtor who asks for a plan longer than the longest plan approved without a Financial Status Report, the number of months on the repayment plan request is fixed only after the debt carries a waiver request, received in the last six months, with the debtor's signed Financial Status Report attached.

Restated: for a plan sought beyond the no-report length, the months on the request are set only once the debt's records hold a waiver request received within the last six months that has the debtor's signed Financial Status Report attached. A plan sought within the no-report length is not held to that.

The recording tool records, on a verified caller's behalf, one pending repayment plan request on one debt, received today by phone, stating the number of months the plan is to run. The request carries no Financial Status Report of its own and proposes no installment. The debt's balance and status are not changed.

## How it is invoked

The tool is `record_repayment_plan_request_018c5870`. The representative unlocks it and calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `debt_id` | The reference number of the VA debt the plan is for, as shown on the debt record returned by the debt lookup for this debtor | Identifier text |
| `requested_term_months` | The number of months the plan is to run | An integer count of whole months, at least 1 |
| `received_within_hold_window` | Whether today falls inside the debt's collection-hold window counted from its notice date | `true` when today is within that window; `false` when today is after that window has closed |

## Return

A successful call returns `request_id` (reference number of the plan request; its presence means the request is on file), `debt_id`, `request_kind` (always "repayment_plan"), `received_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `requested_term_months` (integer months) and `decision_outcome` (always "pending").

## Hypothetical illustration

A request for 9 months on a debt whose hold window closed long ago returns a request reference with `request_kind` "repayment_plan", `requested_term_months` 9 and `decision_outcome` "pending"; the debt's status is unchanged.
